generation.scope: A square-root tangent has a symmetric bordered 5-by-5 octic. If its determinant is nonzero and the corank-two locus is finite, all admissible roots form one sign orbit of double points, including nonreduced finite Frobenius sources. The weighted symmetric minor resolution gives uniqueness and a nonzero second-order obstruction. A clean genuine opposite root makes both roots reduced isolated. For reduced sources with no four collinear points and no triple octic or a unique normal one, the admissible root scheme has length at most two modulo signs. This gives a finite regularity decision for all marked trisecant pairs meeting the middle-configuration conditions.

open_mathematics: Extend the bordered tangent octic and its root classification to nonnormal divisors and nonreduced tangencies. Analyze higher-cofactor and reducible genuine opposite octics and uncovered general windows.
